chunks: And by this chain, he said, Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said:
Every man who is managed by a woman, so he is accursed.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a man managed by his wife?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise hadith from Imam Ali (AS) linking female management of a man to divine curse (*mal'un*), emphasizing the principle of *qiwamah* (male guardianship) within the familial hierarchy. Shia scholars often interpret this not as absolute subjugation but as a warning against the reversal of natural leadership roles that leads to domestic discord and neglect of duty.

en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
Every man who is managed by a woman, so he is an accursed’.
en.sarwar: 10. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “’Amir al-Mu’minin ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A man who follows (unlawful) policies of woman is condemned.’”
